why.title: Group blocks for teams and events
why.body: Athletic teams: contracted rate, breakfast included, 10+ room blocks welcome. Admitted-student weekends: group block for prospective families visiting campus.

why.title: Free hot breakfast + parking + pool
why.body: Free breakfast starts at 6 AM. Free parking, indoor pool, laundry, high-speed Wi-Fi. Everything included in the room rate.

faqs.q: Is there a parent-weekend rate at Le Moyne?
faqs.a: Yes. Call (315) 883-8288 during parent weekend and mention Le Moyne — we offer a preferred rate for visiting families.

faqs.q: Do you accept group blocks for athletic teams?
faqs.a: Yes. We host visiting NCAA D-II teams regularly. Contracted rate, breakfast included, 10+ rooms welcome. Email hotel@syrcicerohotel.com.

faqs.q: Are the rooms big enough for parents plus students?
faqs.a: Every room is a suite with separate living area. 2 Queen Suites sleep four; King Suites have a fireplace and a sleeper option. Perfect for family weekends.

faqs.q: Is there space for admitted-student weekends?
faqs.a: Yes. We hold group blocks for admitted-student events — call the sales team to set up.

faqs.q: How far is downtown Syracuse for evening plans?
faqs.a: Downtown Syracuse is 14 minutes south via I-81. Armory Square restaurants and JMA Wireless Dome events are easy evening drives.

faqs.q: Is breakfast really free?
faqs.a: Yes. Hot breakfast starts at 6 AM and is included with every room.

reviews.author: Le Moyne parent · October 2025
reviews.text: We got a King Suite for parent weekend — fireplace and living room made it feel like an Airbnb. Breakfast at 6:30 AM before the campus tour was clutch.

reviews.author: Visiting coach · March 2026
reviews.text: Blocked 12 rooms for our team's weekend at Le Moyne. Coach's suite was quiet. Kids loved the pool. Front desk was patient about check-ins spread over three hours.
